title: [dvs] test_port_breakout_multiple test case unstable
author: daall
body: `test_port_breakout_multiple` is failing ~50% of the time at the moment, need someone to take a look at it and see if it is a timing issue or if the virtual switch is crashing during one of the steps.

comments.author: daall
comments.body: @zhenggen-xu let me know if you/the team aren't able to repro locally. I can do a few runs on one of the jenkins workers and send the logs over.

linkedPullRequests.title: [dvs] Fix unstable DPB and NAT test cases
linkedPullRequests.author: daall
linkedPullRequests.body:
- Re-enable test_port_dpb
- Add polling to NAT

Signed-off-by: Danny Allen <daall@microsoft.com>

**What I did**
I re-enabled the DPB test because it is now passing consistently and I added a skip to the NAT test because it is broken.

**Why I did it**
To un-block two tests that have been removed from the test suite for an extended period of time.

**How I verified it**
Ran both locally x10.

**Details if related**
Fixes #1222
